implementation: Extended Chatpilot runtime acceptance with CHATPILOT_ACCEPTANCE_TOOLSET=all-chatbot so a live session can expose the full 26-tool chatbot-visible Chatpilot toolset.
Added toolSchemaRoundTrip report extraction from the live adapter summary by comparing SDK session.create tool descriptors with Codex thread/start dynamicTools.
Kept C2 benchmark prompts safe and app-level by using save_memo and list_memos under 26-tool availability, with prompt-local tool-call observations and conservative full-trace native-tool checks.
Kept B5 schema round-trip as a Codex-adapter-only assertion; Copilot CLI has no Codex dynamicTools trace and is not failed for that not-run field.

dataLevelEvidence: Two concurrent Chatpilot routes completed save/list flows.
Each route persisted a distinct marker in its own SQLite memory_memos rows.
Both routes kept distinct SDK session ids and reused the same app-level runtime session on the second turn.

rawArtifacts.purpose: C2 cross-backend comparison plus B5 codex schema proof

dataLevelEvidence: Both backends persisted one or more SQLite memory_memos rows for their route.
Both backends invoked save_memo and list_memos through Chatpilot SDK-visible tool handlers.
Codex adapter exposed all 26 SDK tool schemas as Codex dynamicTools without schema mutation.

knownScopeBoundary: C2 live benchmark uses safe save_memo/list_memos prompts while all 26 tools are available; it does not intentionally execute external-side-effect tools such as WorkProof push, browser, or web search.
Full prompt-quality tuning across every tool description remains better aligned with Phase 6 model-behavior cleanup items C3 and C4.

verification.command: npx tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ES2022 --moduleResolution node --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck examples/chatpilot-runtime-acceptance.ts

notes: A first sandboxed live run failed before Chatpilot startup because uv could not read /Users/rickwen/.cache/uv/sdists-v9/.git; the same command passed after running with approved escalated filesystem access.
An intermediate all-backends run exposed a harness bug where Copilot CLI was failed for not having Codex dynamicTools trace; the harness now treats B5 as a Codex-adapter-only assertion.
Audit pre-check hardened native-tool detection to scan both marker-scoped transcript entries and the full adapter trace, then regenerated both live artifacts.
